name: Lawful Good
flavor: You do the right thing, and you do it the way it's supposed to be done.

name: Neutral Good
flavor: You help where help is needed. The rulebook is somebody else's problem.

name: Chaotic Good
flavor: Your conscience gives the orders, and it doesn't much care who disagrees.

name: Lawful Neutral
flavor: You keep to the code. Whether the code is kind isn't the point.

name: Neutral
flavor: You take each thing as it comes and don't pretend to a side you don't hold.

name: Chaotic Neutral
flavor: Your own freedom comes first. Everything else is negotiable.

name: Lawful Evil
flavor: You take what you want, in order, within the limits you've agreed to.

name: Neutral Evil
flavor: You do what you can get away with, and you're honest with yourself about it.

name: Chaotic Evil
flavor: You answer to appetite. Restraint was never the interesting part.
